verdict.rationale: The product is an API, so it is inherently headless. It documents API keys exported as environment variables, runnable curl/Python/JS requests, OpenAI-compatible REST and gRPC endpoints, an asynchronous Batch API, and a Management API, all of which suit unattended automation. Grok Build is also offered as a CLI. There is no first-party documentation of CI usage or a non-interactive CLI mode. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., a GitHub Actions recipe), a documented headless/non-interactive mode for the Grok Build CLI, independent hands-on reports of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Create an API key via the API Keys page, then export it or add it as an environment variable
The Batch API lets you process large volumes of requests asynchronously with reduced pricing and higher rate limits.
The Management API serves as a dedicated interface to the xAI platform, empowering developers and teams to programmatically manage their xAI API teams.
Agentic coding with Grok Build (grok-4.7), our coding model, on the API and CLI.
